skills.name: Brain Record
lines: Place a Scope on a single enemy
* When not in Another Force or Stellar Burst: Detect stats on a single enemy
** Displayed stats will reflect any active stat buff/debuff on the enemy
* Grant Kaleido to user; change element of user attacks to target's element (Permanent)
** When multiple choice is random. Crystal weakness is always chosen if it's present.
** Non-type attacks become elemental without change in skill multiplier
** Skills from equipment also change
** Effect is based on when skill was used
*** If to the selected element is removed, skill needs to be reused in order to detect a new (if there is any)

abilities.name: Arcana Stacking
lines: When not in Alchemic High state:
*Gain +1 Arcana per user's attacking skill used
*Gain +5 Arcana when Lunatic is activated from basic attack or Valor Chant
*Gain +5 Arcana at start of battle
* When 5 Arcana - at turn-start: consume 5 Arcana to enter Alchemic High State
** The required amount of Arcana needed to enter Alchemic High State increases each successive mode change (5/10/20/40/80)
** Can enter Alchemic High State max 5 times
* Max Arcana: 80

abilities.name: Crystal Buff - Crystal Stance - Cr.
lines: When in Crystalline Stance: Crystal type attack of all party members +15% \ 30% \ 45% \ 60%
* effect's power is based on number ( 1 \ 2 \ 3 \ 4 ) of Crystal type moves used during the turn.
** double moves from Copy status are counted twice. Attack again moves are each counted.
** End-of-Turn, counters, knocked back or dead allies' moves are not counted.
** Counting Rules - in-length explanations
